lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular spatial distribution of high-luminance circular pixel clusters along the mid-lateral flank, forming a grid-like pattern that extends from the posterior gills to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, dark, elongated pixel clusters attached to the ventral-lateral region, consistent with commensal organisms.
